Thanks for the demo earlier — that was really helpful. A few items the team wants to validate before we move toward a pilot:

- Retrieval latency: typical p50/p95 for a 1M record vector store with 1536-dim embeddings (warm cache vs cold).

Hi Tara — great to meet earlier, and thanks for the concise list. Below is a proposed plan and immediate answers; Dylan will follow up with the concrete numbers and a runnable test config.

Quick answers:
- Typical p50/p95 (1M vectors, 1536-dims, warm cache): p50 ~12ms, p95 ~48ms for a single-node Dedicated instance running our ANN + rerank path. Cold-cache (first-time queries, disk-backed shards) can be 120–300ms depending on shard hotness and network.
- Recall@1/5/10: We'll run the evaluation on your sample dataset — preliminary Redwood internal runs on similar retail datasets show recall@1 ~0.72, recall@5 ~0.88, recall@10 ~0.92 for our default rerank pipeline vs VendorX reported recall@1 ~0.65 on same size/config (results vary by query distribution).
- Vector dims & cost: 1536-dim vectors give ~18% better recall on average vs 1024-dim on product-description tasks; storage and query CPU cost is ~1.5x. We'll include a per-million-vector storage + query estimate in the pricing doc.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) Dylan to run targeted rerank + ANN tests on your sample data (1M vectors, both 1536 and 1024 dims) — deliverable: CSV with p50/p95 latency, recall@1/5/10, cost delta. ETA: 48 hours.
2) Provide you a sandbox account (GCP us-central1) and the rerank_test_config.json we use to reproduce results — ETA: 72 hours.
3) Quick sync with Ben + procurement to capture any contracting/discount needs; I'll loop Markus for any discount approval.

Attachments I've added: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf (high-level per-M vector cost and estimated monthly ops cost).

Does that timeline work?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Reranking & embeddings follow-up — initial asks

Hi Tara — quick update with the concrete test plan and some preliminary numbers from our dry-run on a 1M vector synthetic replica (same distribution you shared):

Test config (attached rerank_test_config.json):
- Dataset: 1,000,000 vectors (product descriptions)
- Embedding dims: 1536 and 1024 (two runs)
- ANN index: HNSW + product-quantization for disk-backed shards
- Rerank: cross-encoder re-scoring on top-100 candidates
- Environment: Dedicated node in us-central1 (n1-standard equivalent + V100), warm cache (recently queried), and cold-cache run (after index page-in)

Prelim numbers (synthetic run - will rerun on Acme sample overnight):
- 1536 dims, warm cache: p50 = 11.8ms, p95 = 46.9ms. Cold-cache: median ~180ms, p95 ~420ms.
- 1024 dims, warm cache: p50 = 9.1ms, p95 = 38.4ms. Cold-cache: median ~140ms, p95 ~350ms.
- Recall on synthetic: 1536 => recall@1 0.71, recall@5 0.87, recall@10 0.91; 1024 => recall@1 0.62, recall@5 0.82, recall@10 0.88.

Cost delta estimate: 1536 vectors ~1.5x CPU cost at query time vs 1024 (higher rerank compute and larger ANN operations). Storage delta ~1.45x. We'll produce a per-1M-vector monthly estimate in the attached redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf.

Next actions:
- I'll start the run on Acme's sample dataset tonight and upload redwood_rerank_bench_summary.csv to the Drive link by tomorrow morning.
- Marissa: will you provision the sandbox account for Tara and Ben? We can create an account scoped to read-only for the vector store + ability to submit 1k queries.

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
